ai.literal: In the daytime, conquers the owl, the crow; hostility to conquer, for kings is needed the right time.
ai.translation: A crow can defeat an owl in the daytime; likewise, kings who wish to conquer their enemies must choose the right time for action.
ai.modern: பகலில் காகமானது ஆந்தையை வென்றுவிடும்; அதுபோல, பகைவரை வெல்ல விரும்பும் அரசர்களுக்கு ஏற்ற காலம் தேவையாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of timing in achieving victory. An owl is naturally stronger than a crow, yet during the day when the owl cannot see, even a simple crow can defeat it. Similarly, even the most powerful rulers cannot overcome their enemies by raw strength alone; they must wait for the opportune moment when their opponents are vulnerable and the circumstances are in their favor.

ai.literal: Acting to suit with the opportune time is the rope that binds fortune without leaving.
ai.translation: Acting in perfect agreement with the opportune time is the rope that binds Fortune, preventing her from departing.
ai.modern: உரிய காலத்தோடு பொருந்துமாறு செயல்படுதல், செல்வமகளை நம்மை விட்டு நீங்காமல் கட்டி வைக்கும் கயிறு ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of timing in securing prosperity. The poet uses the metaphor of a rope to show how one can hold onto the otherwise fleeting goddess of fortune. Acting in harmony with the right season or opportunity is the only way to bind success to oneself. Without proper timing, even great efforts fail to retain wealth and fortune.

ai.literal: Difficult tasks, they say, are there any? If one acts with the proper means, having known the right time.
ai.translation: Are there any tasks said to be impossible, if one acts with the proper means after choosing the right time?
ai.modern: தகுந்த கருவிகளுடன், ஏற்ற காலத்தை அறிந்து ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், செய்ய முடியாத அருமையான செயல்கள் என்று ஏதேனும் உண்டோ?
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of timing and preparation in achieving difficult goals. The author asks rhetorically if there is any task too difficult to accomplish in this world. The answer is no, provided two conditions are met: one must act with the appropriate resources or instruments and perform the action at the most opportune moment. When correct timing and proper means come together, even the most challenging endeavors become easily achievable.

ai.literal: Even if the world is desired, it will come to hand, if one acts having considered the right time and with the right place.
ai.translation: Even the entire world can be successfully acquired if one acts at the right time and chooses the right place.
ai.modern: தகுந்த காலத்தை ஆராய்ந்து, ஏற்ற இடத்தோடு பொருந்துமாறு ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், உலகத்தையே அடைய விரும்பினாலும் அது கைகூடும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme power of choosing the right time and place for any action. Even an ambition as massive as conquering the entire world (ஞாலம்) is achievable (கைகூடும்) if one acts. The two essential conditions for this success are carefully choosing the opportune moment (காலம் கருதி) and operating from the most advantageous location (இடத்தால்). Success is presented not as a matter of mere strength, but as a result of perfect alignment with time and space.

ai.literal: The right time keeping in mind they will wait, without getting agitated, the world those who aim for.
ai.translation: Those who aim to conquer the world will wait patiently without wavering, biding the right time.
ai.modern: உலகத்தை வெல்ல நினைப்பவர்கள், மனம் கலங்காமல் அதற்குரிய ஏற்ற காலத்தை எதிர்பார்த்துக் காத்திருப்பார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the strategic patience required for achieving monumental goals. Those who aspire to conquer or rule the entire world ('ஞாலம் கருதுபவர்') do not act impulsively or lose their composure. Instead, they remain completely unagitated ('கலங்காது') and wait ('இருப்பர்') for the most opportune moment ('காலம் கருதி'). Their stillness is not inaction, but a calculated wait for the perfect time to ensure absolute victory.

ai.literal: The withdrawal of him who has determination is of the nature of a fighting ram's retreating to strike.
ai.translation: The temporary retreat of a person of great determination is like the drawing back of a fighting ram to gather momentum for a powerful strike.
ai.modern: ஊக்கமுடைய ஒருவனின் அடக்கம் அல்லது பின்வாங்குதல், சண்டையிடும் ஆட்டுக்கடா தாக்குவதற்காகப் பின்வாங்கிப் பாயும் தன்மையைப் போன்றது.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the strategic value of waiting and temporary withdrawal using a vivid natural image. A person of great determination does not rush into action prematurely; their quiet restraint or retreat is not a sign of weakness or fear. Instead, it is compared to a fighting ram that steps back only to gain the momentum needed for a forceful attack. This teaches that patience and timely retreat are active, strategic preparations for ultimate victory.

ai.literal: Suddenly at that very moment outwardly they will not boil with anger, the right time having watched, internally they will boil with anger, the wise.
ai.translation: The wise will not show their anger outwardly at the very moment of provocation; instead, they keep it boiling within, waiting for the right time to act.
ai.modern: அறிவுடையவர்கள் தமக்கு ஒரு தீங்கு நேர்ந்த உடனே வெளியில் கோபத்தைக் காட்ட மாட்டார்கள்; தகுந்த காலத்தை எதிர்பார்த்து, அதுவரை கோபத்தை மனத்திற்குள்ளேயே வைத்திருப்பார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains how wise and capable people manage their anger when provoked by an enemy. Instead of reacting instantly and showing their anger outwardly, they keep their resolve and anger burning silently within. They patiently wait for the opportune moment to strike back effectively. The word 'வேர்த்தல்' (literally to sweat) is used here metaphorically to mean boiling or simmering with anger, highlighting the intense but controlled nature of their strategy.

ai.literal: If one sees enemies, let one bear them; if one sees their end time, their head will become downward.
ai.translation: When you meet your enemies, bear with them and carry them on your shoulders; when their end-time arrives, their heads will fall headlong.
ai.modern: பகைவர்களைக் கண்டால் அவர்களைப் பொறுத்துக் கொண்டு தோளில் சுமக்க வேண்டும்; அவர்களது இறுதிக்காலம் வரும்போது, அவர்களது தலை கீழே விழும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the strategic importance of patience and timing when dealing with powerful adversaries. The term 'சுமக்க' (bear/carry) advises a person to patiently tolerate and even humor their enemies, acting with submissiveness as if carrying them on their shoulders. This is not weakness, but a calculated delay until the right moment. When the enemies' destined time of ruin ('இறுவரை') finally arrives, their downfall will be automatic and complete, described vividly as their heads falling headlong ('கிழக்காம் தலை').

ai.literal: To attain rare-thing when obtained, at that very moment, to do difficult deed [one must] do.
ai.translation: When an opportunity that is rare to obtain comes your way, use that very moment to perform the deed that is otherwise difficult to achieve.
ai.modern: கிடைப்பதற்கு அரிய காலம் வாய்க்கும்போது, அந்த கணத்திலேயே, செய்வதற்கு அரிய செயலைச் செய்து முடிக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the critical importance of seizing the right moment. The phrase 'எய்தற்கு அரியது' refers to a rare and hard-to-get opportunity, while 'இயைந்தக்கால்' means when such an opportunity actually presents itself. The word 'அந்நிலையே' highlights the urgency, meaning 'at that very instant' without any delay. By acting immediately when the rare moment arrives, one can successfully accomplish a 'செய்தற்கு அரிய செயல்'—a great deed that is otherwise impossible to achieve.

ai.literal: Like a heron, remain folded at the (unfavorable) time; and then, like its strike, (act) when the opportune time arises.
ai.translation: One should remain inactive like a resting heron when the time is unfavorable, but strike with swift precision like that heron the moment the right opportunity arises.
ai.modern: காலம் சாதகமாக இல்லாதபோது கொக்கைப் போல ஒடுங்கி இருக்க வேண்டும்; காலம் வாய்க்கும்போது அதன் குத்துப்போலத் தப்பாமல் விரைந்து செய்து முடிக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet uses the vivid metaphor of a hunting heron to teach the art of timing. A heron stands perfectly still, folding its wings and appearing completely harmless while waiting for prey. Similarly, a wise person must bide their time patiently and keep a low profile when circumstances are unfavorable. However, the moment the right opportunity presents itself, the heron strikes with lightning speed and absolute precision. In the same way, one must act decisively and without hesitation when the perfect moment arrives.
